title: A Tide for the Letters Revisited
author: J. M. Lockridge
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
